Bobb reads your calendar to prepare meeting briefs and uses it to create or change events you request, following your app boundaries.
Bobb reads and updates events on this Mac when you request calendar work.
Bobb reads, creates and updates reminders you request, following your app boundaries.
Bobb helps with your reminders on this Mac when you request it.
Bobb searches contacts on this Mac to resolve exact people and addresses for your requests.
When you talk to Bobb, it listens through the microphone. Your voice is turned into text on this Mac and never sent anywhere.
Bobb turns what you say into text on this Mac, with on-device recognition only. Nothing is sent to Apple or anyone else.
Bobb uses Mail, Messages and Music on this Mac for your requests, following your allow, ask or never rules.
